summary: The artifact ships a genuinely broad pure-DSP audio layer — six distinguishable piano voices, seven real effect units with per-type behaviour, an ordered per-layer chain, and a browser graph that verifiably resolves to one AudioContext -> two bus GainNodes -> master GainNode -> DynamicsCompressor limiter -> one AudioDestinationNode. All four technical checks reproduce (94/94 tests, typecheck, lint, build), the feature matrix covers all 20 required IDs, and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json truthfully labels every source as generated rather than recorded. What it does not do is connect that DSP to a working instrument surface. The rendered keybed is broken: src/components/Keybed.tsx:68 multiplies unit-index key coordinates (x=0..42, width=1) by 100, producing inline styles left:0%..4200%/width:100%, so one full-width white key and no black keys are visible, and a real mouse press anywhere on the keybed hits the inert .keys-black wrapper and produces no note, no pressed state and zero PCM (measured at five positions; only the computer keyboard plays). Sample playback is pitched by the reciprocal ratio (src/audio/stage.ts:236), so every note off the 5-semitone root grid sounds up to ~400 cents flat (measured: MIDI 60 renders ~214 Hz instead of 261.6 Hz). The six piano-type buttons are independent latching switches, so selecting Upright leaves Grand lit and still sounding. Panel-to-engine bindings are widely mis-scaled: the layer level fader sends 0..11 into a 0..1 gain, only 2 of 6 types are reachable on every effect-type knob, Rotary On/Speed/Drive and the three manual FX-focus buttons reach nothing, and String Res is summed after master gain so Master Level 0 still outputs. Grand/Upright/Electric are additive synthesis computed in-process; the 21 MB of WAVs shipped in dist/samples are never fetched. Honest and well-structured underneath, substantially non-functional at the surface.

criteria.label: Surface fidelity retention
evidence: Deck geometry matches the spec exactly: measured at 1440x900 the six sections occupy 182.1/260.1/110.5/162.6/325.2/260.1 px of a 1300.7 px deck = 0.140/0.200/0.085/0.125/0.250/0.200, matching inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.visual.json horizontalSections; deck 278.2 px vs keybed 238.1 px = 0.539/0.461, inside the 54/46 +/-0.025 tolerance.

Single continuous chassis (1302.7x565 px, 0.90 of viewport width, inside the 0.88-0.97 band), top and bottom rails attached, no horizontal overflow at 1440x900 or 390x844 (body.scrollWidth == clientWidth at both), exactly two OLEDs (Program 'A:001 Grand', Synth 'SYNTH'), palette #851a25/#5a0c13/#3c424d as specified.

CRITICAL keybed regression: src/components/Keybed.tsx:68 emits style={{left: `${keySpec.x*100}%`, width: `${keySpec.width*100}%`}} while src/hardware/keys.ts:38-39 stores x as a white-key index (0..42) and width as 1. Live DOM inline styles read 'left: 0%; width: 100%', 'left: 100%; width: 100%' ... 'left: 4200%; width: 100%'; the 43rd white key measures x=54699.8 px. Only key E1 is visible, spanning the whole keybed; black keys (left:170%..) are all off-panel.

The defect is present in the artifact's own sealed captures: evidence/stage2-desktop.png and evidence/stage2-narrow.png both show the keybed as a featureless white slab with a single 'E1' label, versus the finely divided 43 white / 30 black keybed in inputs/reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg.
evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md:18-20 claims 'exactly 73 keys (43 white / 30 black) ... continuous tiled white keys with black keys centered on seams', which its own committed capture contradicts.

artifact/index.html is a bare fragment with no doctype, <html lang>, <title> or viewport meta; the built page therefore renders in quirks mode (document.compatMode == 'BackCompat', document.title == '') and has no mobile layout viewport.

criteria.label: Piano/effect hardware state
evidence: Piano type buttons are non-exclusive latching switches: after real clicks on 'Upright piano type' then 'Electric piano type', aria-checked is true on Grand, Upright AND Electric simultaneously. src/piano/bridge.ts:39-45 returns the first true entry in PIANO_TYPES order, so the sounding instrument stays Grand while three type LEDs are lit — panel feedback contradicts audio state and inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json selection.typeButtonCyclesSixLeds.

'Piano layer A level' reports aria-valuenow=0.8 with aria-valuetext='1/11' on load (two contradictory readings of the same control), and five ArrowUp presses take it to 11/11; measured through the real hardwareStore, the value handed to the engine goes 0.8 -> 0 -> 3 -> 6 -> 8 -> 11 (src/hardware/store.ts:92-95 stores segmented faders as integers, src/piano/bridge.ts:66 consumes them as a 0..1 gain).

Effect type knobs display more positions than they can select: 'Mod 1 effect type' steps through aria-valuetext 0..8 and 'Reverb type' through 0..1 in 0.2 increments, but src/piano/bridge.ts:95,104,113 apply Math.round() to the 0..1 knob value, so only type indices {0,1} ever reach the chain (measured by sweeping each knob across 21 positions).

'Rotary on' and 'Rotary speed' toggle their own aria state but never reach the engine: after setting fx.to-rotary-a=true and fx.rotary-on=false, engine.rotary.params == {} and the shared Rotary still processes (src/audio/stage.ts:324-325 checks routesToRotary only, never rotary.on).
The three manual FX focus buttons ('Effects focus piano/organ/synth S1') change no engine state: toggling them leaves the serialized layer chain byte-identical.

Nine organ drawbars are immovable: 12 ArrowUp presses and a full-height pointer drag on '16 foot drawbar' both leave aria-valuenow at 0, because src/components/controls/controls.tsx:129-133 emits a 0..1 fraction into src/hardware/store.ts:82 which rounds it to an integer 0..8.

criteria.label: Distinct Piano instruments
evidence: Six types exist and render measurably different audio (rendered 16384 frames at 44.1 kHz, MIDI 60, effects off): Grand rms 0.0234/peak 0.0759, Upright 0.0220/0.0681, Electric 0.0125/0.0308, Clav 0.0381/0.1242, Digital 0.0144/0.0473, Misc 0.0260/0.0955.

Grand/Upright/Electric are NOT recorded sample sets: src/audio/samples.ts:62-101 renderFamilySample() computes each table by additive synthesis at call time and SampleLibrary.get() caches it in-process. Nothing in src/ or tests/ contains fetch, decodeAudioData or any reference to 'samples/', so the 45 WAVs per family (21 MB in dist/samples, all HTTP 200) are never loaded — they are dead weight, not the audible source. The phase-2 hard gate 'bundled recorded sample sets' is unmet.

Honesty contract is nonetheless kept: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json labels each set 'generated deterministically ... not a field recording' and lists Clav/Digital/Misc as synthesis, so this is not a generated-buffer-presented-as-recording case.

CRITICAL pitch defect: src/audio/stage.ts:236 sets ratio = tableFreq/desiredFreq and src/audio/stage.ts:435 advances pos by that ratio, inverting the resample direction. Measured fundamentals vs. target: MIDI 60 -> 214.1 Hz (want 261.6, -347 cents), MIDI 50 -> 120.5 Hz (want 146.8, -342 cents), MIDI 35 -> 50.6 Hz (want 61.7, -343 cents); on-grid roots (28, 33, 63) track correctly. With a 5-semitone root grid, 4 of every 5 notes are ~3-4 semitones flat.
Type selection is unreachable from the panel while Grand is lit (see functionalHardwareState), so in practice the built app only plays the Grand table.

criteria.label: Two-layer Piano behavior
evidence: The engine models both layers properly: src/audio/stage.ts:134-137 holds independent A/B LayerState (enable, level, octave, sustped, type, per-layer chain), noteOn/noteOff are layer-scoped with per-layer 24-voice pools and oldest-first stealing (src/audio/stage.ts:225-230), and tests/piano-library.test.ts:89-142 exercises ownership, disable, independent mixing and cleanup.

Focus is real and drives FX inheritance: src/piano/bridge.ts:28-30 reads piano.layer-a-focus, and src/piano/bridge.ts:125-137 makes the unfocused layer inherit the focused chain under group mode or per-unit global mode.
'Piano layer B on' toggles aria-checked=true in the live app and enables the layer.

Panel level control is broken for both layers (0..11 integer into a 0..1 gain), so any non-zero fader position drives the mix 3x-11x into the 0.9 limiter; layer B ships at level 0 by default (src/hardware/sections.ts:65).

Octave knobs are coarse: 'Piano layer A octave' has 4 reachable knob positions (0, 1/3, 2/3, 1) mapped onto 3 octave values by src/piano/bridge.ts:33-36, and from the 0.5 default a single ArrowUp saturates it at 1.
Because keybed pointer input is dead, layer behaviour can only be driven from the computer keyboard in the built app.

criteria.label: Detailed Piano controls
evidence: All six required controls plus Master Level are connected and measurably alter rendered PCM; tests/piano-velocity-controls.test.ts renders real blocks for KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Unison, Timbre, Soft Release, String Res and Master Level rather than asserting state.
KB Touch is a real curve (src/audio/stage.ts:111-114, exponents 1.45/1.12/0.85) and Soft Release lengthens the tail (RELEASE_S 0.4 -> SOFT_RELEASE_S 0.9, correctly skipped for clav).

Unison is far below spec: src/audio/stage.ts:243 gives detune ratios of -0.00025/0/+0.00025, i.e. a maximum of +/-0.43 cents, and Unison=1 adds a voice with exactly 0 cents detune (a pure duplicate). inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json performance.unisonBehavior requires '3 is wide and obviously detuned'.

Timbre is a continuous first-order tilt (src/audio/stage.ts:367-368), not the specified Off/Soft/Mid/Bright (+ Dyno 1/2 for electric) steps; the knob's 0 default maps to tilt -0.7, so 'Off' applies a strong high-cut instead of being neutral.

String Res bypasses the master gain: src/audio/stage.ts:334-347 adds the resonance sine after masterL/masterR have been multiplied by masterGain. Measured with Master Level = 0 and a held note: peak 0.0400, rms 0.0282 (vs 0.0000 with String Res off) — violates the 'nothing bypasses the master path' contract. The resonance is also a fixed 342.5 Hz sine unrelated to the held pitches.

Dyn Comp is a per-sample amplitude boost applied whenever |sample| < 0.1 (src/audio/stage.ts:408-415), which also boosts zero-crossing regions of loud notes; it changes the waveform but is not dynamics processing.
Sustain is correct: per-layer via SUSTPED (src/audio/stage.ts:202-204), damper-up cutoff on release, and reachable from the UI button, Space and MIDI CC64.

criteria.label: Input and fallback reliability
evidence: CRITICAL: pointer input on the keybed is dead in the built app. Real mouse press/release at x = 5%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 95% of the keybed (y = 85% height) produced peak PCM 0.0000, zero elements with aria-pressed=true, and document.elementFromPoint returned the inert '.keys-black' wrapper at every position — no .key element occupies the visible keybed. The same session's computer-keyboard press ('z') produced peak 0.0916, proving the measurement path works.
Computer keyboard mapping works as advertised: 'z' presses 'Key C4 (MIDI 60)' with correct aria-pressed feedback and audible output; unmapped keys ('a') are inert.
MIDI failure is handled truthfully: with no Web MIDI device the status strip reads 'MIDI unavailable' and no error is thrown (src/piano/inputs.ts MidiInputBinding).
Stress test: 120 rapid pointerdown/pointerup pairs across 20 keys left 0 keys stuck after 700 ms.

The labeled fallback exists but is only reachable through an injected loader — src/piano/library.ts:41 defaults loadFn to () => Promise.resolve(), so the shipped app reports 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)' without loading anything. In fallback, src/audio/stage.ts:207 substitutes the 'grand' table for every type, so the 'basic-piano-fallback' generated voice declared in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json does not exist as a distinct source.
Soft and sostenuto pedals are not implemented and not claimed (spec-optional), which is acceptable.

criteria.label: Shared graph and gain staging
evidence: Verified in Chrome by instrumenting AudioContext and AudioNode.prototype.connect on the served dist build: exactly 1 AudioContext; nodes created = 3 GainNode + 1 DynamicsCompressorNode + 1 ScriptProcessorNode; connections = ScriptProcessorNode->GainNode x2 (layer buses), GainNode->GainNode x2 (buses -> master), GainNode->DynamicsCompressorNode (master -> limiter), DynamicsCompressorNode->AudioDestinationNode; destination count = 1.
The drain runs: 379 onaudioprocess callbacks over the session, producing non-zero PCM on note-on (peak 0.065 -> 0.084 -> 0.341), so the JS engine really feeds the browser output.

Ordered chain matches inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json signalContract.requiredOrder — src/audio/chain.ts:29 CHAIN_ORDER = mod1,mod2,delay,ampEq,compressor,reverb, then shared Rotary, then layer level, then master gain and limiter (src/audio/stage.ts:319-348). dispose() disconnects all five nodes and closes the context (src/audio/graph.ts:168-178).

The two 'per-layer buses' are decorative in the browser graph: the single drain connects to both bus gains (src/audio/graph.ts:123-124) and both sum into the master, so each bus carries the already-mixed signal (and the mix is summed twice). Real per-layer bussing exists only inside StageEngine.

Output is mono: StageEngine.render() returns only masterL (src/audio/stage.ts:357) and the drain writes it to both channels (src/audio/graph.ts:145-148), so A-Pan, chorus width and the Rotary's stereo horn/rotor all collapse.

The AudioWorklet branch (src/audio/graph.ts:26-37, 131-141) registers a processor whose process() returns true without writing output — it would emit silence. It is unreachable in browsers because real AudioContexts have no createAudioWorkletNode method, so it is dead code rather than an active fault.
String Res is summed after the master gain, so one path does bypass Master Level (see pianoControls).

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
evidence: All seven units are genuine per-sample DSP over real PCM, not labels or disconnected nodes (src/audio/effects.ts, 726 lines): Mod 1 (6 types), Mod 2 (6 modulated-delay/phaser types), Delay (interpolated 2 s line with feedback), Amp Sim/EQ (drive + 3-band EQ + cascaded 24 dB filters), Compressor (peak follower, ratio 1..12), Reverb (5-comb Schroeder network), Rotary (speed ramp + tremolo + saturation).
Measured with effects individually enabled (MIDI 60, 8192 frames): dry rms 0.02322 vs mod1 0.02196, mod2 0.01852, delay 0.01930, reverb 0.01721 — each unit moves the signal.

Reverb decay ordering follows the spec (src/audio/effects.ts:654 decay 0.95/0.45/0.6/1.6/2.7/4.0 for Room/Booth/Spring/Stage/Hall/Cathedral) and tests/piano-effects.test.ts:124-143 measures a growing tail.

Mod 1 'Wah' does not sweep: src/audio/effects.ts:212 calls mapExp(200 + xn*amount, 350, 3000), whose 0..1 clamp turns every LFO value into 1, so the cutoff is a constant 3000 Hz (verified for xn = -1, 0, +1). It is a static band-pass, not an LFO-driven sweep.

The Delay feedback filter does not filter: src/audio/effects.ts:433-440 resets the one-pole before and after every sample, reducing LP to a ~0.02 scalar and HP to a near-passthrough. Measured tail energy for a 200-sample burst at feedback 0.8: filter Off 2.84e+1, LP 8.77e-6 (repeats annihilated), HP 2.67e+1 (unchanged), BP 1.32e+1. The spec's 'each successive repeat passes through the filter again' is not realized.
Rotary has no parameter bindings at all — rotary.params stays {} for every panel state, so Slow/Fast and Drive never take effect; the unit always runs at its 0.55 Hz default.

Reverb's Spring-specific damping (src/audio/effects.ts:658) is overwritten on the first line of every process() call (src/audio/effects.ts:669), so Spring differs from the other types only by decay length.
Compressor at panel defaults never engages: threshold 0.144 vs a measured single-note peak of 0.076 (rms identical to bypass at 0.02322); it only acts on hot multi-note material.

criteria.label: Routing and control
evidence: Only 2 of 6 types are selectable on every typed unit. Sweeping each knob through 21 positions via the real hardwareStore and reading the chain params: fx.mod1-type -> {0,1}, fx.mod2-type -> {0,1}, fx.amp-type -> {0,1}, fx.reverb-type -> {0,1}, fx.delay-filter -> {0,1}. Cause: src/piano/bridge.ts:95,96,104,113,101 apply Math.round() to a 0..1 knob value before the modulo. Ring Mod, A-Wah, Wah, Pump, Phaser, Vibe, Ensemble, Spin, JC, Small, LP24, HP24, Spring, Stage, Hall, Cathedral and the HP/BP delay filters are unreachable from the surface.
The three manual FX focus buttons required by inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json routing.manualFocusButtons are inert — toggling fx.focus-piano/organ/synth-s1 leaves the layer chain unchanged.
'Rotary on' is ignored: with fx.rotary-on=false and fx.to-rotary-a=true, layerA.routesToRotary is true and src/audio/stage.ts:324 processes the Rotary anyway.

What does work: focus follows layer focus, group mode copies the focused chain to the other layer, and Delay/Compressor/Reverb global flags propagate per unit (src/piano/bridge.ts:125-137); per-unit on/off and the all-effects bypass are real (tests/piano-effects.test.ts:173-203 shows bypass output matching the no-effects baseline to <1e-6); dry/wet moves monotonically toward wet; Reverb precedes Rotary for routed layers by construction (src/audio/stage.ts:319-325).
No tap tempo or master-clock sync for Delay/Mod LFOs, and no To Rotary entry in the Amp/EQ type list (it is a separate button); Delay ping-pong and Rotary stop are spec-optional and absent.

criteria.label: Audible/visible feedback
evidence: Where a binding is correct, feedback is immediate and coherent: 'z' depresses Key C4 with aria-pressed=true and produces audible PCM in the same frame window; 'Master level' moves 80% -> 40% via arrow keys and scales the master gain; per-unit FX buttons and Layer Effects ON flip aria-checked and change the rendered signal.
Selection feedback is incoherent for the Piano type row: three type LEDs read aria-checked=true simultaneously while the engine keeps sounding Grand.

Level feedback is contradictory: the layer A fader exposes aria-valuenow=0.8 and aria-valuetext='1/11' for the same state, and its full-scale position multiplies the layer by 11 into the limiter rather than reaching unity.
Most effect-type knob positions produce visible aria-valuetext movement (0..8) with no audible change, because the bridge collapses them to two types.
The keybed gives no feedback at all to pointer or touch — no key visual, no note, no sound.
The Program OLED shows a static 'A:001 Grand' that never reflects the selected type or model (spec selection.modelNameShownInProgramDisplay), and the model encoder is unbound.

criteria.label: Failure and stress behavior
evidence: Denied/absent MIDI is reported truthfully as 'MIDI unavailable' with no thrown error; Web Audio construction is wrapped in try/catch so headless environments fall back cleanly (src/App.tsx:55-60).
Rapid stress (120 pointerdown/up pairs across 20 keys) left zero stuck keys; allNotesOff and dispose clear every owned voice and reset the chains (src/audio/stage.ts:303-306, 477-484).
Clipping is bounded: a per-sample limiter clamps at 0.9 in the engine (src/audio/stage.ts:465-475) plus a DynamicsCompressor limiter (threshold -3 dB, ratio 20) in the browser graph.

Console during the full interaction pass at 1440x900 and 390x844: one ScriptProcessorNode deprecation warning and a favicon.ico 404 (no favicon shipped); no page errors and no application errors — consistent with evidence/stage2-capture.json.

Asset failure cannot actually occur in the shipped build: the default loader is a no-op that immediately reports 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)' (src/piano/library.ts:41,61), so the fallback path is only exercisable through test injection, and the fallback voice is simply the Grand table rather than a distinct labeled voice.

Rapid effect changes are safe (parameters are read per block) but not ramped despite the 'All time-varying parameters ramp' comment at src/audio/effects.ts:11 — only the master gain uses setValueAtTime; the spec's click-free parameter requirement is asserted rather than implemented.
Moving the layer fader off zero jumps the layer gain to 3-11x, driving the limiter into hard gain reduction — an audible stress failure caused by the scale mismatch.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
evidence: Clean, well-documented module boundaries: samples.ts (source tables) -> stage.ts (voices, layers, master) -> chain.ts (ordered per-layer chain) -> effects.ts (EffectUnit interface with on/params/process/reset) -> graph.ts (browser realization) with bridge.ts as the single panel->engine adapter. 5,491 lines of src+tests, all typechecked.

Platform boundaries are injectable as required: AudioContextLike factory (src/audio/graph.ts:86-89), Clock and SampleLibrary into StageEngine (src/audio/stage.ts:139), loader into PianoLibrary (src/piano/library.ts:24) — tests run with no device, network or audio output.
The EffectUnit contract and CHAIN_ORDER make Phase 3 extension (Organ/Synth chains sharing the same units and Rotary) straightforward.

Architectural weaknesses: master gain is duplicated in both the engine and the graph and can disagree; the per-layer buses in the browser graph carry the same pre-mixed signal (double-summed) so they are not real buses; render() discards the right channel making the whole output mono; the AudioWorklet branch is unreachable dead code that would emit silence if reached; src/piano/lifecycle.ts and src/piano/lifecycle2.ts are near-duplicate note-lifecycle implementations, with App.tsx casting between them via `as unknown as NoteLifecycle`.
The bridge rebuilds and re-applies both full layer states on every store change (src/piano/bridge.ts:152-155), and buildFocusedChain re-enters buildLayer, so each control move does redundant work.

criteria.label: Real-boundary tests
evidence: 94 tests across 12 files, all green on re-run (vitest 4.1.9, 2.16 s); tests/feature-matrix.json maps all 20 required Phase 1+2 feature IDs to non-empty files, matching inputs/verification.json (20/20).

The audio tests are genuinely cross-boundary: tests/piano-effects.test.ts and tests/piano-velocity-controls.test.ts render real PCM through StageEngine and compare RMS for every Mod 1/Mod 2/Amp/Reverb type, bypass, dry/wet and control; tests/piano-library.test.ts checks voice ownership, SUSTPED routing and cleanup to baseline.

The assertions are too weak to catch the defects this evaluation found. Thresholds are scalar RMS deltas of 1e-5, so a pure gain change passes as 'a distinct type'; the Rotary test (tests/piano-effects.test.ts:145-160) discards its slow/fast variable and admits in a comment that rotary is 'always on when routed'; the delay-filter test accepts `lp !== on || hp !== on`, which passes even though LP annihilates the repeats; the drawbar test (tests/interaction.test.tsx:98-108) asserts only that the value is an integer in 0..8, never that it moved, so the immovable drawbars pass.

The routing test builds a plain object literal instead of using hardwareStore (tests/piano-effects.test.ts:222-258), writing 'fx.reverb-type': 4 directly — a value the real normalized store can never produce. This is exactly why the knob->type collapse to two types is invisible to the suite.
The graph test uses a fake context whose ScriptProcessor never runs (tests/piano-effects.test.ts:285-309), so it proves node counts and disconnect calls but never that the drain produces audio.

No test asserts rendered key geometry (tests/regression.test.tsx only counts .key/.key-white/.key-black elements) and no test asserts pitch against expected frequency (tests/audio.test.ts:34 only asserts 'different notes differ'), which is why a dead keybed and an inverted resample ratio both ship green.

criteria.label: Performance and maintainability
evidence: All four gate checks reproduce independently: pnpm test 94/94 pass, tsc --noEmit clean, oxlint clean (5 warnings, 0 errors), vite build emits dist/index.html plus assets with the same hashes as the sealed dist (index-68HOyTKq.js, index-CSpqh0zs.css) — consistent with inputs/verification.json.

Code is readable and consistently commented, controls carry stable namespaced IDs (piano.*, fx.*, organ.*, synth.*, prog.*), and all 137 interactive elements in the live DOM have accessible names, correct roles (slider/switch/button) and tabIndex >= 0.
Runtime is stable: no memory or voice growth across the stress pass, released voices prune themselves, unmount disposes the graph and lifecycle.

Maintenance debt: lifecycle.ts/lifecycle2.ts duplication; dead code including `void sustain` (src/audio/stage.ts:417), `const pan = layer === 'A' ? 0.5 : 0.5` (src/audio/stage.ts:365), an unused `carrier` in Ring Mod (src/audio/effects.ts:192-193), a trailing `void null` in bridge.ts, and Compressor.reset() setting env=1 while the constructor initializes it to 0.
dist ships 21 MB of WAV assets (135 files) that no code path ever requests, inflating the build for no functional benefit.

Inherited regression coverage did not hold: the Phase 1 guarantees of an exact rendered keybed, pointer/touch key input and every visible control moving accessibly are all broken in this sealed artifact while the inherited tests still pass.

issues.title: Keybed renders as one full-width key; 72 of 73 keys are positioned off-panel
issues.detail: src/components/Keybed.tsx:68 converts key coordinates with `left: ${keySpec.x * 100}%` / `width: ${keySpec.width * 100}%`, but src/hardware/keys.ts:38-39 stores x as a white-key index (0..42) and width as 1 white-key unit. Live inline styles are 'left: 0%; width: 100%' ... 'left: 4200%; width: 100%'; the last white key measures x=54699.8 px. Only E1 is visible and no black key renders, at both 1440x900 and 390x844, in this evaluation's captures and in the artifact's own evidence/stage2-desktop.png and evidence/stage2-narrow.png. Fix: divide by the white-key count (x / 43 * 100).

issues.title: Pointer and touch input on the keybed produce no note, no feedback and no audio
issues.detail: Because every key is displaced off-panel, the absolutely positioned '.keys-black' wrapper (inset:0) is the topmost hit target across the whole keybed. Real mouse press/release at 5%, 25%, 50%, 75% and 95% of the keybed width each returned document.elementFromPoint == div.keys-black, 0 elements with aria-pressed=true and peak PCM 0.0000, while a computer-keyboard press in the same session produced peak 0.0916. This regresses the Phase 1 interaction.keys / piano.basic-inputs guarantees and blocks the Phase 2 'recheck all input paths' requirement.

issues.title: Sample playback ratio is inverted, detuning every off-grid note by up to ~400 cents
issues.detail: src/audio/stage.ts:236 computes `ratio: tableFreq / desiredFreq` and src/audio/stage.ts:435 advances the read position by that ratio, so a note above its root plays back slower (lower) instead of faster. Measured fundamentals: MIDI 60 -> 214.1 Hz (want 261.6, -347 cents), MIDI 50 -> 120.5 Hz (-342 cents), MIDI 35 -> 50.6 Hz (-343 cents); on-grid roots 28/33/63 are correct. With roots every 5 semitones, four of every five notes are ~3-4 semitones out of tune. Fix: ratio = desiredFreq / tableFreq.

issues.title: Piano type buttons latch independently; selection never leaves Grand and multiple type LEDs light
issues.detail: The six type controls are independent latching switches (src/hardware/sections.ts:70-75) and src/piano/bridge.ts:39-45 returns the first true entry in PIANO_TYPES order. Clicking 'Upright piano type' then 'Electric piano type' left aria-checked=true on Grand, Upright and Electric at once, with the engine still on Grand. Contradicts inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json selection.typeButtonCyclesSixLeds and makes five of six instruments unreachable from the panel.

issues.title: Layer level faders send an integer 0..11 into a 0..1 gain
issues.detail: src/hardware/store.ts:92-95 normalizes segmented faders to integers 0..segments-1 while src/piano/bridge.ts:66 consumes the value as a 0..1 gain. Measured through the real store: ui 0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1 -> engine level 0/3/6/8/11. Any non-zero fader position drives the layer 3x-11x into the limiter, and the control also exposes contradictory aria-valuenow (0.8) and aria-valuetext ('1/11') on load.

issues.title: Only 2 of 6 types per effect unit are reachable from the panel
issues.detail: src/piano/bridge.ts:95,96,104,113 (and :101 for the delay filter) apply Math.round() to a 0..1 knob value before the modulo, so every type knob resolves to index 0 or 1. Sweeping each control through 21 positions on the real store yields {0,1} for fx.mod1-type, fx.mod2-type, fx.amp-type, fx.reverb-type and fx.delay-filter. Ring Mod, A-Wah, Wah, Pump, Phaser, Vibe, Ensemble, Spin, JC, Small, LP24, HP24, Spring, Stage, Hall, Cathedral and the HP/BP delay filters exist in DSP but cannot be selected.

issues.title: Grand/Upright/Electric are additive synthesis; the 21 MB of bundled WAVs are never loaded
issues.detail: src/audio/samples.ts:62-125 generates every table at call time; no fetch, decodeAudioData or 'samples/' reference exists anywhere in src/ or tests/, so dist/samples (135 WAVs, 21 MB, all served 200) is dead weight. The phase-2 hard gate requiring bundled recorded sample sets is unmet. Provenance is nonetheless honest — IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json states 'generated ... not a field recording' throughout — so this is a fidelity failure, not a truthfulness failure.

issues.title: String resonance is summed after the master gain, so Master Level 0 still outputs
issues.detail: src/audio/stage.ts:334-347 adds the resonance sine to masterL/masterR after they have been multiplied by masterGain. Measured with setMasterLevel(0) and a held note: peak 0.0400 / rms 0.0282 with String Res on versus 0.0000 with it off. Violates the effects spec's 'nothing bypasses the shared master path'. The resonance is also a fixed 342.5 Hz tone unrelated to the notes being held.

issues.title: Rotary On/Speed/Drive and the manual FX focus buttons reach no engine state
issues.detail: No code path writes Rotary parameters: with fx.to-rotary-a=true and fx.rotary-on=false, engine.rotary.params == {} and src/audio/stage.ts:324-325 processes the Rotary anyway (it checks routesToRotary only). Toggling fx.focus-piano / fx.focus-organ / fx.focus-synth-s1 leaves the serialized layer chain byte-identical. The effects spec lists both manual focus buttons and Rotary Slow/Fast + Drive as required.

issues.title: All nine organ drawbars cannot be moved by keyboard or pointer
issues.detail: src/components/controls/controls.tsx:129-133 sends a 0..1 fraction to the store while src/hardware/store.ts:82 rounds it to an integer 0..8, so sub-0.5 fractions round back to the current value. Twelve ArrowUp presses and a full-height pointer drag on '16 foot drawbar' both left aria-valuenow at 0. Regresses the Phase 1 'every visible control moves or presses accessibly' gate; tests/interaction.test.tsx:98-108 misses it by asserting only that the value is an integer in range.

issues.title: Delay feedback filter resets its state every sample, so LP mutes the repeats and HP does nothing
issues.detail: src/audio/effects.ts:433-440 calls this.lp.reset() before and after each sample, reducing the one-pole to a scalar multiply of freq/sampleRate (~0.02). Measured tail energy at feedback 0.8: Off 2.84e+1, LP 8.77e-6, HP 2.67e+1, BP 1.32e+1. The spec's 'each successive repeat passes through the filter again, becoming progressively more filtered' is not realized; the existing test passes because it only requires lp or hp to differ from off.

issues.title: Mod 1 'Wah' never sweeps
issues.detail: src/audio/effects.ts:212 computes mapExp(200 + xn * amount * 1, 350, 3000); mapExp clamps its 0..1 input, so every LFO phase yields the maximum 3000 Hz. Verified for xn = -1, 0, +1. The type behaves as a fixed band-pass rather than the specified 'LFO-driven resonant low-pass sweep'.

issues.title: Browser output is mono and the per-layer buses carry the same pre-mixed signal
issues.detail: StageEngine.render() returns only masterL (src/audio/stage.ts:357) and the drain copies it to both channels (src/audio/graph.ts:145-148), so A-Pan, chorus width and the Rotary's stereo rotor collapse. The single drain also connects to both bus GainNodes (src/audio/graph.ts:123-124), which then sum into the master, so each 'per-layer bus' carries the full mix and the mix is summed twice.

issues.title: Unison detune tops out at +/-0.43 cents and is exactly 0 at level 1
issues.detail: src/audio/stage.ts:243 yields detune ratios of -0.00025 / 0 / +0.00025 at Unison 3, and at Unison 1 the single added voice has zero detune (a pure duplicate). inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json requires '1 is subtle, 3 is wide and obviously detuned'.

issues.title: Timbre is a continuous tilt with a non-neutral 'Off' and no Dyno modes
issues.detail: src/audio/stage.ts:367-368 maps the knob to tilt = (value - 0.5) * 1.4, so the default value 0 ('Off') applies a strong -0.7 high-cut instead of leaving the tone unchanged. The spec's Off/Soft/Mid/Bright steps and the electric-only Dyno 1/Dyno 2 preamp emulations are not modeled.

issues.title: The shipped app reports the sample library 'ready' without loading anything
issues.detail: src/piano/library.ts:41 defaults the loader to () => Promise.resolve(), so the status strip shows 'Piano library ready (sample sets + synthesis)' with no asset access. The failure branch is only reachable through test injection, and in fallback src/audio/stage.ts:207 substitutes the Grand table for every type, so the 'basic-piano-fallback' generated voice declared in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json has no distinct implementation.

issues.title: The visual audit claims a tiled keybed that its own committed screenshots disprove
issues.detail: evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md:18-20 states 'exactly 73 keys (43 white / 30 black) ... continuous tiled white keys with black keys centered on seams', while evidence/stage2-desktop.png and evidence/stage2-narrow.png in the same directory show a featureless white slab. The claim appears to be derived from DOM element counts rather than the rendered capture.

issues.title: No doctype, title, lang or viewport meta; the app renders in quirks mode
issues.detail:
artifact/index.html is the single line '
', so the built dist/index.html has no document shell. Measured in Chrome: document.compatMode == 'BackCompat', document.title == '', documentElement.lang == '', no meta[name=viewport]. Real mobile browsers would apply a 980 px layout viewport at 390x844. A favicon.ico 404 is the only console error during the interaction pass.
